title: Verification record
description: The verifier's verdict on one candidate: what it checked, what it found, and what it decided. Lives in data/verification/<run-date>/<id>.json. Kept for every candidate, including rejected ones, so decisions can be audited.

decision.description: publish = written to data/events; hold = needs a person (reason given); reject = not published (reason given).

reasons.description: Plain-English reasons, one per line. Required for hold and reject; for publish, note any fields removed.

result.description: confirmed = the quote was found AND it says what the record says; contradicted = the page says something different; unverifiable = quote not found or page unreachable.

method.description: exact/near = scripts/check_quote.py found the quote; read = page read by the verifier because the script could not (e.g. page built by JavaScript); none = nothing could be checked.

page_status_seen.description: What the primary page says about availability right now.

existing_event.description: Path in data/events if this event was already published, else null.

changes.description: For an existing event: what is different now.

decided_by.description: verifier by default. 'human' when a person overrides a hold (e.g. after phoning the venue); reasons must say what they checked.
